patch_instances: patch detectron2 Instances class with a statically-typed scriptable class for TorchScript compilation
patch_nonscriptable_classes: patch ResNet and FPN backbone classes to use ModuleList for TorchScript compatibility
patch_builtin_len: patch builtin len() function in detectron2 modules to use __len__ for tracing friendliness
freeze_training_mode: freeze training mode annotations on a model's submodules to meta-compile away training codepaths
script_torchscript_model: script a detectron2 model with TorchScript by applying instances, backbone, and training mode patches
